title: Samsung Tizen Smart TV Unauthenticated Remote Control Command Execution
description: Samsung Tizen Smart TVs with firmware prior to 1120.0 expose an unauthenticated HTTP REST API on port 8001/8002 allowing adjacent network attackers to issue arbitrary keystroke and control commands without user pairing.
remediation: Update Samsung Smart TV firmware to version 1120.0 or later and enable Secure PIN Pairing.

title: LG webOS Smart TV Account Creation and Authorization Bypass
description: LG webOS Smart TVs running webOS 4.x through 7.x allow adjacent network attackers to bypass authentication on the second-screen service (port 3000) by manipulating internal variable configurations, enabling privileged account creation.
remediation: Upgrade LG webOS software to the latest security patch release and isolate smart TVs on a dedicated media VLAN.

title: LG webOS Smart TV Arbitrary Command Injection in Process Manager
description: An OS command injection vulnerability in the process-manager service of LG webOS allows authenticated local or adjacent network attackers to execute arbitrary system commands as root.
remediation: Apply LG security firmware patch version 4.30.25 or later.

title: Daikin BRP Wi-Fi Air Conditioner Controller Unauthenticated Settings Manipulation
description: Daikin AirBase BRP069 Wi-Fi adapters expose unauthenticated HTTP control endpoints (/aircon/set_control_info) allowing any local network device to tamper with climate temperatures, HVAC operation modes, or cause denial of service.
remediation: Restrict HVAC Wi-Fi controllers to an isolated VLAN and update Daikin adapter firmware.

title: Gree / Midea Smart Air Conditioner Unauthenticated Local UDP Broadcast Hijacking
description: Smart air conditioners utilizing legacy Gree/Midea Wi-Fi modules use hardcoded encryption keys (a3K8BsHG8esIKWHz) over local network control packets, allowing unauthorized heating/cooling manipulation.
remediation: Migrate air conditioners to dynamic token authentication and isolate HVAC units on VLAN 99.

title: Radio Thermostat CT50 / CT80 Unauthenticated HTTP REST API Temperature Override
description: Radio Thermostat CT50 and CT80 devices expose an unauthenticated HTTP REST API on port 80 (/tstat and /sys). Any adjacent host can read room temperatures, alter target HVAC setpoints, or induce high-frequency relay cycles.
remediation: Apply firewall ACLs restricting access to the thermostat IP and disable unauthenticated local web control.

title: Xiaomi Mi Smart Standing Fan / Purifier Local Token Replay & Control Override
description: Xiaomi Mi Smart Standing Fan 2 devices allow adjacent network attackers to replay captured handshake tokens or exploit default administrative passwords on port 8080 to override fan oscillation and motor speed.
remediation: Change default passwords, update fan firmware via Mi Home app, and isolate IoT smart home accessories.

title: Tuya Smart SDK Local Key Replay & Appliance Relay Override
description: The Tuya Smart SDK implements weak local encryption protocols (version 3.1) permitting adjacent network eavesdroppers to decrypt local control payloads and manipulate fan speeds, light relays, or appliance state.
remediation: Update Tuya device firmware to version 3.3+ utilizing encrypted key exchange.
